mcq_drop.why: oddly worded R ('Brahmins were a caste of the Satavahanas'); A-R link ambiguous

patterns: APPSC asks single-fact items: Ikshvaku woman patron of Buddhism = Bodhisiri (with Chantisiri/Adavi Chantisiri as traps).
'Most important literary source for Satavahana social life' = Hala's Gathasaptasati, with Puranas/Dharmasutras as distractors.
Statement pairs on the Vedic varna order and the Satavahanas' role (APPSC-GS 2024); Maiputa/Kusuma Lepanam term (APPSC 2019).
App adds many sound match items (sub-caste occupations, Anuloma/Viloma, Vishnukundin titles) at a depth slightly beyond the PYQs.
